name: k8s cluster-state dead-man — no pod phase rows for 20 min
description: Fires when ZERO k8s.pod.phase datapoints arrive in the trailing 20 min (evaluated every 10 min). The k8s_cluster receiver emits one per pod every 30 s, so silence means the poweredge-xubuntu collector, its scoped kubeconfig, or the API server it reads is down, and every workload trigger beside this one is blind. UNGROUPED and unfiltered, because a grouped query cannot fire on a silent subject. Emitter: k8s_cluster on the poweredge-xubuntu collector (thewoolleyman/otel-collector config.ci-runner-host.yaml, item livespec-dev-tooling-ec2rkp). Receiver: the poweredge-xubuntu otel-collector (thewoolleyman/otel-collector config.ci-runner-host.yaml) -> Honeycomb env livespec. Runbook: ssh poweredge-xubuntu; systemctl status otel-collector; journalctl -u otel-collector --since -30min; kubectl --kubeconfig /etc/otel-collector/kubeconfig get pods -A. Plan kubernetes-node-observability (livespec-dev-tooling-dfdiil), item livespec-dev-tooling-t6om4l.
